{"id":1982182218,"question_id":4284,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months","timestamp":1776566273,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1982182218/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Smallest Stable Index I","memory":"31.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int firstStableIndex(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<int>min_right(n);\n        min_right[n-1] = nums[n-1];\n\n        for(int i = n-2 ; i>=0 ; i--){\n            min_right[i] = min(min_right[i+1] , nums[i]);\n        }\n\n        int max_left = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++){\n            max_left = max(max_left , nums[i]);\n            if(max_left - min_right[i] <= k) return i;\n        }\n        return -1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"smallest-stable-index-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1929}
